title: Fast template compilers for all sub-games and 9-mode archive
body:
INSTANT COMPILERS FOR ALL SUB-GAMES
- Deterministic in-memory template matching is now active across Polish Counties (Powiatdle), Polish Voivodeships (Województwodle), and US States (US Statedle).
- Common queries about city vs. land counties, registration plate lengths, rivers, neighboring countries, and regional affiliations compile in under 5 milliseconds without invoking AI models.
- Intercepts and immediately answers a large portion of daily sub-game queries for faster response times.

ARCHIVE FOR ALL NINE GAME MODES
- The Archive page now allows exploring past daily challenges across all 9 game modes (Countrydle, Flagdle, the 4 continental challenges, US States, Województwa, and Powiatdle).
- Easily switch between modes with responsive mode tabs and dropdowns to review past solutions.

SMARTER GUESS INPUT PROTECTION
- Entering a question into the guess box is now automatically detected, preventing players from accidentally wasting a valuable guess attempt.
- The game automatically redirects the query to the Question tab in Countrydle and Continental challenges.
- Direct submissions of question text to the guess endpoint receive a clear and helpful explanation.
